name: Lemon-Lime Soda I
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Remove the zest from the lemons and limes in strips, leaving behind the bitter white pith.
Combine the sugar and zest in a container, and let this sit in the fridge for 24 hours. The sugar will extract the liquid from the citrus peels and produce a syrupy liquid.
Strain the solids out of the peel and sugar mixture.
Mix the peel and sugar mixture with lime juice. This should produce slightly under ½ cup (120 ml) of syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of carbonated water.

culture.text: }}Lemon-lime soda is a carbonated beverage flavored similarly to lemon- and limeade. This recipe originates from Flavorlab.
